name: Coven’s Focus (Coven)
body:
Channel your spells through your coven members’ bonded objects and familiars.

Prerequisite(s): Caster level 3rd; coven member; possess an arcane bond, familiar, or soul focus.

Benefit(s): When you cast a spell with a range of touch, you may apply it to any member of your coven currently wearing, wielding, or touching their familiar, arcane bonded object, or soul focus item.
